purpose: Teach: 反転/利潤/インフォメーション/呼称/ジレンマ/主たる/オファー/売上げ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業績の反転戦略を立てましょう
lines.en: Let's develop a strategy to turn our performance around.
lines.style: Brisk, direct opening. Clipped tone, forward momentum. A leader moving the meeting along. No hesitation, no softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。利潤の構造を分析中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm analyzing the profit structure now.
lines.style: Clean, ready-to-deliver response. Slightly faster pace than Yuki — eager to show progress. Professional but warm, the reliability of a colleague who has already started the work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様にインフォメーションをわかりやすく伝えましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we communicate customer information clearly and simply.
lines.style: Measured directive. Slight emphasis on 'clearly' — this matters. Not demanding, but firm. The tone of someone who knows customer confusion costs money.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内用語の呼称を整理しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already organized our internal terminology.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Light note of quiet pride — the work is done. Steady, no flourish. Just the fact delivered clean.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 若手のジレンマを聞き取りましょう
lines.en: Let's listen to what the younger staff are struggling with.
lines.style: Thoughtful pivot. Slightly slower, more human. She's shifting from process to people. A leader checking in. Open, inviting input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。主たる得意先を再確認しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently verifying our main accounts again.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. The sound of someone already three steps ahead. Respectful pace. No rush, just thorough completion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外からのオファーも記録しましょう
lines.en: Let's also record any offers that come in from overseas.
lines.style: Forward-looking, inclusive. Slightly lighter than the previous directives — opening a new avenue. Professional curiosity. The door stays open.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。月次の売上げ集計を完了しました
lines.en: Yes. I've completed the monthly sales tally.
lines.style: Clean close. Slightly heavier emphasis on 'completed' — the project is finished. Warm finality. The period at the end of the sentence lands.
